title: chore: merge develop into next
body:
This syncs the `next` branch with the latest changes on the develop branch. Doing this from time to time will help maintaining the two different codebases.

- We made the code a bit more robust on `develop` and added some tests that we can leverage on `next`.
- An annoying part was the upgrade to Prettier 18 that doesn't format the same on the two branches.
- The e-commerce example works on CodeSandbox on the `develop` branch.
- Etc.

comments.body: @samouss I didn't because merging seemed to be easier here. Do you think rebasing would have been more straightforward in that case?
@francoischalifour I've no idea but it would make the history better if we merge the branch once we release the branch `next` as `stable`.
